findings.problem: Artifact binding omits grading implementation bytes. Editing scoring normalized() after blind export changes scores without invalidating the bound artifact/packet.
findings.suggested_fix: Record actual SHA-256 of the scorer, imported validation scoring helper, and core in artifact_binding; existing private binding equality must reject changed grading sources.

Existing private binding comparison rejects changed scoring code in a fresh CLI process; immediate rehash rejects stale in-memory artifact objects.

verified.runtime_schema: Real CPU prepare and prior real final artifacts agree with actual current core/Modal field shapes. The historical final artifact is v3, not a new v4 selected-only test, so it does not by itself prove a complete new test can load. Current run_evaluate/selection_gate code was inspected for the v4 shapes.
verified.freeze: Exact local selection/manifest/protocol/ASR-selection bytes must equal execution commit. Manifest and protocol SHA bind pre-test selection, and selection SHA binds execution proof.
verified.selected_weights: Exactly one selected variant and adapter descriptor, selected checkpoint and train-run/hash consistency; base rejects adapter contamination. Modal selection_gate checks the actual validation result hash and adapter_descriptor checks saved checkpoint files before execution.
verified.generation_and_sources: Current user, original voice intent, image/family/reference, split/variant/counts and assets are checked; system/history derive from committed manifest and bound runtime sources. Greedy generation and 384 cap are hardcoded in bound runtime implementation.
verified.manual: All 147 manual grades need Boolean decisions, reasons, independence/private-map attestations and source-image inspection for EOS-complete photo cases. No semantic points are guessed by the scorer.
verified.completion: Strict required raw suffix/EOS metadata; non-integer/negative IDs, missing EOS, truncation/unknown and over-cap generations fail completion; exact-cap EOS remains complete. ASR completion is disclosed separately.
verified.arithmetic: Test 42/84/18/10/3/13/4/4 denominators and 178/22 totals are used; Fraction macro mean of five capabilities and full-denominator micro; no validation 75600 weights, eligibility gates or new selection.
verified.cer: Independent codepoint Levenshtein over original strings and separately NFKC/whitespace-removed strings; punctuation/case retained after NFKC, no script conversion; zero/greater-than-one CER handled; not folded into LM macro.
verified.grading_code_freeze: Actual self/imported validation helper/imported core SHA-256 and byte counts are recorded in artifact_binding. Rehash at export and score detects source drift even with stale in-memory artifacts. Original post-export CLI casefold bug now rejects before writing scores.

limitations: No actual new final-test artifacts or selected pre-test decision were reviewed because the new test is unrun and candidate validation outputs are out of scope.
No fresh semantic grading and no actual source-photo inspection for answer correctness; this is an implementation review.

Physical base/ASR weight SHAs are known from actual CPU prepare receipts, but test loader checks HF model/revision pins and runtime selection, not a per-forward full weight-file rehash. Do not claim per-test physical-file revalidation.
Raw records do not independently log system/history or rendered chat-template input token IDs. Prompt evidence scope states this accurately.
Independence/source-image inspection are grader attestations, not mechanically provable by the scorer; external actual task/source-read evidence remains necessary.
Selected adapter SHA identifies inference weights. RNG/resume checkpoint files are runtime checkpoint-integrity evidence, not a claim that inference depends on or replays training RNG.
Source bindings compare local bytes with reported execution commit; authenticity of execution provenance still relies on actual Actions/Modal handoff evidence.
conclusion: No open concrete implementation defect found after author correction and fresh independent checks. This is scorer readiness evidence, not actual selected-model test or semantic-grade evidence.
